title: Bologna Children’s Book Fair 2024
summary: Our first international book fair with our own stand.
body:
Our first international book fair with our own stand: four days of rights meetings and conversations with publishers, illustrators, translators, agents and authors in the colourful world of children’s books.

[Read our report from the fair](/news/bologna-childrens-book-fair-2024/)
